subject: CardiaScale: request for onboarding uplift + extended discount (exec signoff needed)
messages:
From: Jane O'Neill <jane.oneill@cardiascale.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot ask: onboarding uplift + 9-month discount extension

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product checks most of the boxes for our remote monitoring workflow. Procurement is ready to move on a 12-month pilot but we need two adjustments before legal will sign: a one-time onboarding uplift (to cover our extra integration work) and an extension of the early-adopter discount from 3 months to 9 months to help justify the initial integration cost to our board.

Numbers we are looking at: $120k TCV pilot; onboarding uplift of $18k; and an effective discount of 25% for months 1–9 (then revert to standard starter tier). If you can accommodate this we can get a PO issued next week.

Attachments: CardiaScale_Requirements_annotated.pdf (we can upload if useful)

Best,
Jane O'Neill
CFO, CardiaScale
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot ask: onboarding uplift + 9-month discount extension — need exec signoff

Team — forwarding CardiaScale's request. Quick summary: 12-month $120k pilot, asking for $18k one-time onboarding uplift and a 25% discount for months 1–9.

Why I think we should consider:
- Strategic account in cardiac devices vertical (good reference potential).
- Pilot has realistic chance to convert to a multi-year expansion (they flagged integrations into EHR and device telemetry).

Concessions asked:
- One-time onboarding uplift: +$18k (they want us to absorb integration project overhead)
- Extended discount: 25% for months 1–9 (standard early-adopter we offer is 3 months at 20%)

Possible compromise I propose: grant the onboarding uplift at 50% ($9k credit) plus extend discount to 6 months at 20% to limit margin impact. Marcus — can you run margin impact quickly? Marissa — can you flag whether this fits strategic reference criteria? Karthik — any legal/term concerns if we do a staggered discount (e.g., defined rollback and usage caps)?

I will coordinate communication back to Jane once we have a direction.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-17T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: onboarding uplift + 9-month discount extension — need exec signoff

Lauren — thanks for the note. High level: I support moving this forward with constrained concessions if the account signs a reference clause and commits to a joint case study if pilot outcomes meet uptime and latency SLAs. Suggested guardrails: 

- Onboarding uplift: we can offer a $12k credit (two-thirds) applied as a one-time invoice credit tied to completion of integration milestones.
- Discount: extend to 6 months at 20% (same as early-adopter) not 9 months at 25%.
- Include a conversion clause: if they convert to an annual commitment >$400k in 12 months, we retroactively apply month 7–9 at 20% as well (i.e., incentive to expand).

Please ensure we add: usage caps (e.g., per-token limit for pilot window) and a defined rollback to standard pricing after month 6. Karthik — you'll need to draft the SOW language for milestone-based credit and procurement-friendly wording. Marcus — please confirm P&L impact with 6-month 20% and $12k credit. I can take the exec sign-off if finance and legal confirm numbers are acceptable.

-Marissa
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-18T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: onboarding uplift + 9-month discount extension — need exec signoff

Quick math (high level) — using conservative usage profile they provided:
- Baseline pilot revenue (no concessions): $120k TCV
- If we apply 6 months at 20% discount across invoiced months (assume even monthly billing): delta =~ $12k revenue reduction over pilot
- Onboarding credit of $12k reduces recognized revenue in Q2 by $12k (applied as invoice credit)
- Net realized revenue over pilot window = $96k (rough) vs. $120k baseline; margin hit depends on included infra credits but overall gross margin remains >55% given our quantization/hosting cost assumptions for this workload.

Notes/asks:
1) If we tie onboarding credit to milestone completion and require PO + signed SOW, we can protect churn risk.
2) Recommend setting a pilot max-usage cap (e.g., 2x expected tokens) and overage pricing at our standard tier to avoid runaway costs.

If product/legal ok with the milestone language, I can endorse the $12k credit + 6-month 20% extension. Marissa — please confirm exec sign-off once you get Karthik's SOW language.

- Marcus
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: margin-impact-estimate.xlsx)
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Jane O'Neill <jane.oneill@cardiascale.com>, procurement@cardiascale.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-03-18T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask: onboarding uplift + 9-month discount extension — next steps and SOW

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear ask and for moving quickly. We had an internal review this morning and Redwood can accommodate a constrained concession that balances your onboarding needs with our pricing guardrails. Summary of what we can commit to: 

- One-time onboarding credit: $12,000 applied after completion of integration milestone #2 (API handoff + initial data ingestion verification).
- Extended early-adopter discount: 20% for months 1–6 (standard early-adopter extended to 6 months).
- Pilot usage cap: 2x expected token consumption; standard overage pricing applies above that cap.
- Conversion incentive: if CardiaScale converts to an annual commitment >$400k within 12 months of pilot start, we will apply an additional credit equivalent to months 7–9 at 20% retroactively.

Next steps:
1) I attached the updated SOW (CardiaScale_SOW_v2.pdf) with milestone language and the invoice credit clause.
2) Karthik will send a clean SOW paragraph for procurement-friendly insertion.
3) If the above is acceptable, I'll route a DocuSign envelope for the SOW and signature. Link to the envelope is here: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ZXNwLWZyZWU=

Please reply with a short confirmation and we will issue a PO template for your procurement team.  Appreciate the speed — we are excited to partner.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: CardiaScale_SOW_v2.pdf)
